title: What to think: a 105-question experiment plan
confirmed_choices: Reactive S2 baselines reason only when the actual user request arrives.
Amortized thinking variants generate earlier earlier results and reuse them.
Retain all history plus earlier results where feasible; use a documented selection fallback on overflow/OOM.
Report native thinking and ordinary output tokens separately; do not force a reasoning trace from Instruct models.
summary: Start with S1 and validate the evaluation pipeline on real model outputs before running more experiments.
Use all 105 distinct questions for the final evaluation, after checking every reference answer.
Use shared 10–40 second chunks for amortized thinking, while keeping each S1 model’s native audio frames.
Compare S1-only responses with reactive S2 and S2 that reuses results generated while listening.
Measure answer accuracy and request-time thinking tokens, and count earlier work separately.
Keep the progress report, examples and checklists synchronized as runs finish.

scope.reference_answer_audio: deferred; text and fact checklists suffice
scope.development: Use separate additional meetings/speakers for prompt and chunk selection; the exposed 105-question bank remains the full evaluation pool.
scope.extra_diagnostic4: The four previous text probes stay separate unless the user later expands the 105-question bank.

chunking.rule: Use at least 10 elapsed seconds and eight seconds of voiced speech; close early after an observed two-second pause, otherwise close at the first observed pause of at least 0.5 seconds after the 25-second target, with a hard cap at 40 seconds.
chunking.cap_rule: At 40 seconds, close at the current audio frame without looking ahead; mark continuing speech as partial and let the next chunk include its continuation.
chunking.low_activity: A capped interval with less than eight seconds of speech is a passive chunk: keep all its samples in history but skip a thinking call; the next active call still has that earlier audio available.
chunking.fillers: Short backchannels and fillers are accumulated with surrounding speech rather than becoming their own calls; a long low-information block may return NO_UPDATE, with its tokens counted.
chunking.request: At request onset, stop launching amortized thinking. Put the unclosed meeting tail and the complete request into the final input, even if the tail is shorter than the normal minimum.
chunking.common_schedule: Use one causal audio-VAD boundary manifest across GT text, both ASR tools and speech S2; no GT sentence boundaries or question-specific evidence may choose the cuts.
chunking.causality: A pause is used only after its silence has been observed; text prefixes include only already available words, never the complete future part of an intersecting utterance.
chunking.same_content: Macro chunks and native S1 frames cover the same original samples, request and source horizon; preserve an interval/hash ledger with no dropped or duplicated speech.
chunking.development: Keep all development settings within the user-approved 10–40 second range; compare 20-, 25- and 30-second targets, then freeze one schedule.
chunking.not_when_study: The schedule is fixed across all conditions; learned semantic trigger timing is deferred.

gold_steps: Keep one evaluation record per distinct question, verify the actual spoken request and its retained intent, and preserve requester and actual insertion time.
Reuse existing draft answers as starting material; generate a candidate answer and required-fact checklist from only the available GT prefix.
Attach source passage IDs, speaker, time, quantities/units, uncertainty and allowed alternative answers; distinguish required facts from optional context.
Check every answer with deterministic number/owner/status checks where possible, a second-model review and Codex inspection of source evidence.
Resolve disagreements and unsupported premises before freezing all 105 references; preserve versions and do not silently drop difficult cases.
Freeze answer facts and judge criteria before any evaluation run; keep them out of model inputs.
protocol: This is an unpaced content study: complete each thinking chunk call before releasing the next chunk; measure accuracy and token movement, without a real-time latency claim.
Amortized thinking branches see only earlier original meeting speech; synthetic evaluation questions and answers never enter the shared earlier meeting history.

At the request, use the whole available history plus retained earlier results; user-request recognition in generated-transcript conditions comes from that tool, with a GT-question-text diagnostic reported separately.
Use the same final-answer instruction and within-model decoding/output allowance across paired conditions.
Full earlier reasoning text and saved notes are retained when possible; chat-template stripping of previous thinking must be checked using actual model inputs.
Track each transcript/speaker revision at its release; do not use full-meeting future diarization or oracle speaker-name mappings in generated-transcript conditions.
Fork independent question examples from the original meeting history; earlier synthetic questions or model replies never become history for later examples.
S2 audio experiments produce text answers and earlier results; native speech is scored in S1. Qualify any S2 engine that cannot separate text/reasoning from speech output.
Reuse causal earlier results per meeting/model/tool/prompt where their exact inputs match, without exposing question times to the worker.

Choose generation limits on development data: start with 8192 new tokens for native Thinking models and 4096 for Instruct, raise if needed for complete outputs, then freeze within-model paired limits and report all length stops.
The appended GT request text must match the chosen recorded question, including any retained alternative; every condition uses the same spoken request and gold intent.

After the request, allow only the fixed silence/EOS needed by native speech decoding, never resumed future meeting audio; save the full output and select scoring spans by timing rather than correctness.
capacity: Preflight audio duration, encoded positions, text length, prior-trace length and output reserve before each family.
Try full history first; reducing concurrency or a qualified larger allocation may resolve memory pressure without changing the model context limit.

When full history cannot fit, retain the request, recent complete chunks and useful earlier results; preserve older commitments, revisions and source anchors with a fixed rule using available information only.
For a paired comparison, use the same selected raw-history intervals and output reserve; list which earlier results were retained or removed.
Keep full-history and budgeted results separate while reporting an all-105 total; log selector version, omitted intervals, cause and actual input counts.

Never silently truncate, use gold evidence to select history, change precision/checkpoint, or omit a question; if even the declared minimum cannot run, record a capacity failure in the all-105 ledger.

Distinguish a model-native rolling context from caller-selected history: consuming a full recording does not prove that every earlier state remains directly accessible. Record native rolling/eviction separately from a selected-history fallback.

DuplexOmni’s released bridge retains150 native turns (about72seconds) by default; its full-history native controls deliberately extend that policy. Count all audio-message, ASR and control tokens, not only the audio expansion of one large WAV, and qualify this extended mode before treating it as an accuracy baseline.
metrics: Primary accuracy: a complete source-supported answer without a material unsupported claim, judged using verified facts, rules and a blinded LLM judge.
Primary token measure: newly generated native thinking after the actual request, excluding all earlier amortized thinking and answer text.
For absent native thinking channels use not-applicable; for unexposed channels use unavailable, never a fabricated zero or a forced chain of thought.
Also list final-answer tokens, total request-time output, request-time input text tokens, earlier amortized thinking output, truncations and context mode.
Report native thinking means over all eligible attempts, correct-only values separately, and accuracy alongside every token comparison; silence and failed answers cannot win on token count.
Use model-specific tokenizers and compare token reductions primarily within the same model; different tokenizers and input costs prevent a universal compute interpretation.
Have the judge see the request, verified facts/source evidence and candidate answer, with model and condition names hidden; inspect disputes directly against the source.
For S1, independently transcribe generated audio and inspect disputed words/numbers by listening; an internal text stream is diagnostic, not a substitute for the spoken answer.
Report per-question logical amortized thinking exposure and the actual unique executed amortized thinking totals separately, so reuse of a shared earlier meeting history is not double-counted.

A helper or selector that uses the actual request performs request-time work: count its native reasoning and ordinary output, never relabel it amortized thinking. The main history selector uses fixed rules.

current_roles.each job / GPU 0: Thinker, Talker, MTP and Code2Wav share the GPU; independent Parakeet ASR follows after S1 shuts down; S2 is disabled.

resources.current_dependencies: Two independent one-RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB jobs compare listening methods; each runs S1 then ASR on GPU 0, with no shared model service, maximum two GPUs. Source checks follow actual output transcription.
resources.policy: Full-matrix stages are sequential; transcript tools and reference validation precede evaluation, and judges follow generation. The current repair pilot uses two independent one-GPU method jobs, with a maximum of two GPUs active. No concurrent S1+S2 integration is part of this matrix.
resources.qualification: Resource counts are planning envelopes, not measured fits; reuse pinned environments/checkpoints and qualify new versions before the full runs.

execution_order: Implement the shared S1 response extraction, scoring, token accounting and progress export, starting with saved real outputs.
Run a small end-to-end S1 pilot with checked reference facts and inspect its actual outputs; pass every evaluation-pipeline check before expanding experiments.
Generate or repair and validate all 105 reference answers, keeping development meetings separate.
Qualify the remaining S1 callers, freeze the evaluator and run S1-only on all 105 questions.
Select chunk thresholds and thinking goals on separate development meetings; qualify S2 context limits, saved-result retention and native token counters.
Run the text-S2 and speech-S2 conditions on all 105 questions, then fill the paired accuracy/token tables.
Keep the progress report, examples, daily log and checklists synchronized throughout; discuss timing and speech handoff later.

terminology.definition: Reason while listening, then save and reuse the results when a user asks a question.
terminology.cost_note: The term describes moving and reusing work before a request; it does not establish lower total compute or latency, which must be measured.
terminology.scope_note: No model training is implied; the current plan reuses inference results.

evaluation_gate.first_model: DuplexOmni S1, using the existing verified S1 caller with S2 disabled
evaluation_gate.scope: First implement and validate the shared evaluation scripts on saved real S1 outputs, then run a small end-to-end S1 pilot on separately checked question examples; these checks do not replace the final 105-question evaluation.
checks: Freeze a small source-checked pilot set with an early question, a later question and a case about task owners or a changed decision; do not tune models or prompts on the final bank.
Save the exact input audio, request timing, checkpoint, context retained, raw output, spoken answer and run status for each case.
Extract the answer from the model’s actual output audio, use independent ASR and listen when names or numbers are unclear; keep native model text separately.
Check required facts, people, numbers, units and decision status, then use a blinded LLM judge for meaning and manually inspect disagreements.
Test correct, incorrect, partial, silent, missing, truncated and capacity-failure records, using existing real outputs where available and clearly labeled script fixtures for remaining error paths.
Check token counts against native token IDs, report absent thinking channels as N/A and leave unexposed counts unavailable.
Verify that all 105 planned questions remain in final accuracy accounting and that reruns cannot duplicate cases or overwrite earlier evidence.
Publish at least one end-to-end pilot example with the actual request, verified answer facts, raw model output/audio, extracted answer, score and a plain explanation.
Rerun the same saved outputs through the evaluator and confirm identical deterministic fields; version and freeze the judge prompt, model, decoding and rules, and record judgment variation.
Verify that the progress report and checklists match the saved run records, including failure cases and update times.
evaluation_gate.pass_rule: Proceed only after every pipeline check is verified and an inspected real S1 pilot example is linked; a wrong model answer can still demonstrate correct evaluation, but a successful process exit alone cannot pass this gate.
evaluation_gate.next: First qualify full-history S1 request recognition and the judge using empty, partial and correct real outputs; then validate all 105 references and qualify the other S1 callers before full-bank evaluation.

requirements: Maintain a run-time report from the same saved run records that determine checklist states and aggregate results.
During a run, refresh the local report after each completed or failed example and at least every 30 seconds; show the last update, active model/condition/job and finished-versus-planned counts.
Show completed answers and scored answers separately, with provisional accuracy only over reviewed results and a separate final score over all 105 questions.
Keep a few actual examples visible, including a correct answer, an error and any silence or truncation; link the request, model output/audio, reference facts, judgment and reason.
Update the public HTML report at run milestones and publish its snapshot time; never label an old published snapshot as live.
Use one versioned progress file to generate the experiment-plan checklist, project TODO and progress page; do not mark a task complete until its linked evidence is checked.
progress_reporting.distinction: Real-time progress reporting tracks the experiment as it runs; the current inference study remains unpaced and makes no real-time response-latency claim.
